snippet.title: SAND - Update Announcement - Accolades Trailer
snippet.description:
Buy SAND: Raiders of Sophie now on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431300/Sand

Get ready for our first major content update - dropping later this month!

SAND is available now in Early Access! Build your highly customizable walking base. Squad up or go solo. Gather loot, weapons, and precious artifacts. Clash with other players in a brutal, procedurally generated desert forged by history and chaos.

Developed by team Hologryph in Lviv, Ukraine. Support Ukraine - https://u24.gov.ua/
